techs.name: Hyperfeed Seedstock Consignment
techs.description: Imported adaptive crop stock, calibrated for this world's soil and pests. Unlocks the Hydrogarden (+2 FOOD slots on farm tiles) and adds +1 FOOD slot on every owned fish tile.

techs.name: Trade Clearance Grant
techs.description: Offworld recognition that lets this planet's surplus be registered as Coin. Unlocks Mintworks.

techs.name: Titanium Forge Module
techs.description: AFC module: a heavy plate-forging system delivered from offworld. Reveals Titanium and unlocks Fort and the Titanium Weapons Factory.

techs.name: Rigging Works Module
techs.description: AFC module: tension frames, cable looms, and umbrite-working tools. Reveals Umbrite and unlocks Umbrite Rig, Siege Outpost, and the Umbrite Weapons Factory.

techs.name: Reserve Custody Cadre
techs.description: Imported custody specialists who process subdued bodies into the House's manpower reserve. Unlocks the Ancillary Depot (+150 Manpower cap).

techs.name: Aether Resonance Core
techs.description: AFC module: the core apparatus that lets House aether-casters work this planet's crystal lattice. Reveals Crystal and unlocks Aether Tower, Aether Condenser, and Aether Purge.

techs.name: Prospector Crew
techs.description: Imported survey-and-drilling specialists configured for this planet's crust and deposit depths. Unlocks Mines.

techs.name: Hydroworks Engineering Crew
techs.description: Imported water engineers who calibrate pressure and filtration to this planet's chemistry. Unlocks Hydroworks: every Hydrogarden within 10 tiles gains +2 FOOD slots.

techs.name: Incubation Corps
techs.description: Imported biological and medical specialists who expand sustained population capacity. Unlocks the Incubation Engine.

techs.name: Umbrite Synthesis Module
techs.description: AFC module: precision tension frames and calibration jigs for this world's umbrite. Unlocks Umbrite Works.

techs.name: Trade Circuit Charter
techs.description: An offworld trade and freight settlement arrangement. Unlocks Trade Nexus and Harbor Exchange.

techs.name: Imperial Tender Warrant
techs.description: Makes this planet's Coin accepted by Imperial factors. Unlocks Clearing House.

techs.name: Bastion Master-Die Module
techs.description: AFC module: the forming die that presses Forge-produced plate into interlocking Bastion shells. Unlocks Titanium Bastion upgrades for existing Forts and keeps +10% settled defense.

techs.name: Siege Lens Foundry Module
techs.description: AFC module: precision optics and targeting apparatus for siege works. Unlocks Siege Tower upgrades for existing Siege Outposts.

techs.name: Hive Mind Module I
techs.description: AFC module: the first offworld half-mind, extending House command over another muster. Adds one Muster tile.

techs.name: Titanium Synthesis Module
techs.description: AFC module: assay standards, furnace salts, and production apparatus that make this planet's titanium usable. Unlocks Titanium Works.

techs.name: Tuned Separation Process
techs.description: An offworld industrial process adapted to this planet's ore. Unlocks the Ore Refinery, which improves nearby Mine output.

techs.name: Provincial Stewardship Corps
techs.description: Imported administrative staff who run this territory's civic institutions. Unlocks Ministry Hall.

techs.name: Dread Tower Cadre
techs.description: Imported permanent operating crew for the House's heaviest siege works. Unlocks Dread Tower upgrades for existing Siege Towers.

techs.name: Thunderplate Induction Module
techs.description: AFC module: induction coils and discharge rails required for live Thunderplate armour. Unlocks Thunder Bastion upgrades for existing Titanium Bastions.

techs.name: Hive Mind Module II
techs.description: AFC module: a second offworld half-mind. A second staging tile means an army can gather while another marches.

techs.name: Census Office
techs.description: Imported census administrators and identification systems. Unlocks Census Hall.

techs.name: Neural Assembly Core
techs.description: AFC module: specialised assembly machinery that equips and maintains ancillary production at scale. Unlocks Neural Works (+0.1 Manpower/min per Ancillary Factory in its connected town network).

techs.name: Reserve Lattice Module
techs.description: AFC module: the assembly machinery behind the House's largest manpower reserve. Unlocks Reserve Lattice (+150 cap and +35% terrain-adjusted base capacity).

techs.name: Ancillary Control Core
techs.description: AFC module: the sealed neural-control and command apparatus that turns subdued bodies into AI-directed ancillaries. Unlocks Ancillary Factory (+0.05 Manpower/min).

techs.name: Population Registry Dossier
techs.description: Reserves an offworld Registry Engine Core for the Population Bureau project.

techs.name: Titanium Levy Dossier
techs.description: Reserves an offworld Levy Command Core for the Titanium Levy project.

techs.name: Echo-Reader Crew
techs.description: Imported specialists who use the local Crystal lattice as a sounding board. Unlocks Survey Sweep, revealing hidden towns, Titanium, Gems, and Umbrite.

techs.name: Counterphase Core Module
techs.description: AFC module: signal-disruption apparatus for offensive aether use. Unlocks Aether EMP.

techs.name: Transposition Array Module
techs.description: AFC module: the field apparatus behind the House's most invasive aether operation. Unlocks Aether Siphon.

techs.name: Aetherward Coil Module
techs.description: AFC module: coil-and-pylon apparatus that projects a defensive aether field over a port. Unlocks Aether Wall.

techs.name: Geoform Engine Module
techs.description: AFC module: heavy field apparatus for large-scale terrain work. Unlocks raising and removing mountains.

techs.name: Augury Office
techs.description: Imported Unblinking Dial, locally cut lenses, and trained Dial Augurs. Unlocks Reveal Empire and Reveal Stats.

techs.name: Tideway Lattice Module
techs.description: AFC module: resonant anchor-piles tuned to local tides. Unlocks Aether Bridge.

techs.name: Stratospheric Dockyard Module
techs.description: AFC module: storm charts, landing corridors, and power routing for this world's skies. Unlocks Sky Dock.

techs.name: Resonance Grid Module
techs.description: AFC module: sensor apparatus tuned to this planet's aether interference. Unlocks Resonance Grid, which denies enemy aerial bombardment in its radius.

techs.name: Catalyst Fabricator Module
techs.description: AFC module: manufactures sealed catalyst hearts for this planet's converters. Unlocks Advanced Umbrite Works, Advanced Titanium Works, and Advanced Aether Condensers (20% more output, retaining their higher Coin refining cost).

techs.name: Imperial Exchange Dossier
techs.description: Reserves an offworld Sovereign Clearing Core for the Imperial Exchange project.

techs.name: Sovereign Siege Engine Dossier
techs.description: Reserves an offworld Aether Bore Core and firing key for the Sovereign Siege Engine project.

techs.name: Aegis Dome Dossier
techs.description: Reserves an offworld Aegis Field Core for the Aegis Dome project.

techs.name: Astral Dock Dossier
techs.description: Reserves an offworld Orbital Keel Core for the Astral Dock project.

techs.name: Matterwright Retort Module
techs.description: AFC module: a retort tuned to this world's mineral temper, able to teach its Crystal to wear another face. Unlocks the Aether Retort, with Umbrite as a selectable output.
